## Definition
The considerations and challenges for integrating self-rectifying memristors into conventional VLSI fabrication processes, including material compatibility and scaling. Determines the practical feasibility of deploying beyond-CMOS crossbar computing in real hardware, bridging lab-scale devices to large-scale TCC and iNEST platforms.
